
![coffe](<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-br">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Luiz Augusto | Developer</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --green: #00ff41;
            --terminal-bg: rgba(0,0,0,0.82);
            --java-color: #f89820;
            --python-color: #3d8fc9;
        }
        * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

        body {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            background: #000;
        }

        #bg {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            z-index: 0;
            filter: brightness(0.55) saturate(1.3);
        }

        .scanlines {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.13) 50%),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,0,0,0.02), rgba(0,255,0,0.01), rgba(0,0,255,0.02));
            background-size: 100% 3px, 3px 100%;
            z-index: 1;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ── PERSONAGENS ── */
        .char-wrap {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            z-index: 10;
            width: clamp(200px, 26vw, 380px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .char-wrap video {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            display: block;
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(0,255,65,0.25)) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.05);
        }

        .char-left  { left: 0; }
        .char-right { right: 0; }
        .char-right video { transform: scaleX(-1); }

        /* Badge de linguagem */
        .lang-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 18px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 9px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            white-space: nowrap;
            z-index: 11;
            border: 2px solid;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        .badge-java {
            color: var(--java-color);
            border-color: var(--java-color);
            background: rgba(248,152,32,0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(248,152,32,0.4);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(248,152,32,0.8);
        }

        .badge-python {
            color: var(--python-color);
            border-color: var(--python-color);
            background: rgba(61,143,201,0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(61,143,201,0.4);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(61,143,201,0.8);
        }

        /* Ícone SVG abaixo do badge */
        .lang-icon {
            position: absolute;
            top: 52px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            font-size: 22px;
            z-index: 11;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px currentColor);
        }

        /* ── TERMINAL ── */
        .terminal {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 20;
            background: var(--terminal-bg);
            border: 2px solid var(--green);
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,255,65,0.45), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,65,0.04);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            max-width: 540px;
            width: 86%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .terminal-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            background: rgba(0,255,65,0.07);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,65,0.2);
        }
        .close-btn {
            width: 18px; height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #ff5f56;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: #7a0000;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: monospace;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            transition: filter 0.2s;
        }
        .close-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.4); }
        .bar-title {
            color: rgba(0,255,65,0.4);
            font-size: 7px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            flex: 1;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .terminal-body {
            padding: 1.8rem 2rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .prompt-line {
            color: rgba(0,255,65,0.4);
            font-size: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .welcome-text {
            color: var(--green);
            font-size: clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px);
            line-height: 2;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,65,0.9);
            display: inline-block;
            overflow: hidden;
            white-space: nowrap;
            border-right: 3px solid var(--green);
            animation: typing 3.5s steps(30, end) forwards, blink 0.75s step-end infinite;
        }

        /* Linha de linguagens */
        .lang-line {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-top: 1.3rem;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease forwards 4.2s;
        }
        .tag {
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 8px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border: 1px solid;
        }
        .tag-java {
            color: var(--java-color);
            border-color: var(--java-color);
            background: rgba(248,152,32,0.1);
            text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(248,152,32,0.7);
        }
        .tag-python {
            color: var(--python-color);
            border-color: var(--python-color);
            background: rgba(61,143,201,0.1);
            text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(61,143,201,0.7);
        }
        .tag-sep {
            color: rgba(0,255,65,0.4);
            font-size: 10px;
        }

        .sub-text {
            display: block;
            font-size: 7px;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: rgba(0,255,65,0.45);
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease forwards 5s;
        }
        .status {
            margin-top: 1.2rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease forwards 5.8s;
        }
        .dot-pulse {
            width: 7px; height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--green);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green);
            animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .status-text {
            color: rgba(0,255,65,0.5);
            font-size: 7px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        @keyframes typing {
            from { width: 0; }
            to   { width: 100%; }
        }
        @keyframes blink {
            from, to { border-color: transparent; }
            50%      { border-color: var(--green); }
        }
        @keyframes fadeUp {
            from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); }
            to   { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%,100% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
            50%     { opacity:0.3; transform:scale(0.65); }
        }

        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .welcome-text { font-size:10px; white-space:normal; border-right:none; animation:none; }
            .char-wrap { width: 130px; }
            .terminal-body { padding: 1rem; }
            .lang-badge { font-size: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; top: 10px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <img id="bg" src="data:image/gif;base64," alt="bg">
    <div class="scanlines"></div>

    <!-- ☕ JAVA — Esquerdo -->
    <div class="char-wrap char-left">
        <span class="lang-badge badge-java">☕ JAVA</span>
        <video autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="data:video/mp4;base64," type="video/mp4">
        </video>
    </div>

    <!-- Terminal Central -->
    <div class="terminal">
        <div class="terminal-bar">
            <button class="close-btn" onclick="this.closest('.terminal').style.visibility='hidden'">✕</button>
            <span class="bar-title">~/luiz-augusto — bash</span>
        </div>
        <div class="terminal-body">
            <div class="prompt-line">$ whoami</div>
            <h1 class="welcome-text">Well Welcome, I'm Luiz Augusto</h1>

            <div class="lang-line">
                <span class="tag tag-java">☕ Java</span>
                <span class="tag-sep">+</span>
                <span class="tag tag-python">🐍 Python</span>
            </div>

            <span class="sub-text">[ Developer in Training ]</span>

            <div class="status">
                <div class="dot-pulse"></div>
                <span class="status-text">ONLINE · LEARNING · BUILDING</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 🐍 PYTHON — Direito -->
    <div class="char-wrap char-right">
        <span class="lang-badge badge-python">🐍 PYTHON</span>
        <video autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="data:video/mp4;base64," type="video/mp4">
        </video>
    </div>

</body>
</html>)
